michaela: FYI ran a 6h perf sweep on L40S with FP8 enabled and we have a consistent p99 spike after warmup when the KV cache hot-set rotates. Noticed automatic fallback to INT8 for some layers around the spike window.

raj: ugh. any repro script? which transformer-engine config did you use?

michaela: repro is in perf-sweeps/2026-03-fp8-l40s. TL;DR: TE v2 + te_kernel_selector=auto + batcher=max_tokens=1024, max_batch=32. Kernel selector flips to int8_dot when sequence len > 512 during burst.

kai: can you paste the profiler excerpt? likely kernel mis-selection heuristics or occupancy mis-estimate.

michaela: profiler snippet (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-12T14:02:33Z] seq=768 qps=4200 alloc=hot
kernel_choice: fp8_qkv_dot (90%) -> int8_dot (10%)
latency_p99: baseline 42ms -> 89ms in window
kv_cache_evictions: 3 -> rewarm cost ~ 11ms/token for first 128 tokens
SM occupancy estimate drop from 78% -> 44% when switching to int8_dot
```

olivia: are we seeing precision calibration exceptions? FP8 needs per-layer scale calibration and TE v2 has that auto-calibration pass - maybe it's aborting and falling back. Any logs from transformer engine?

michaela: TE logs show a calibration warning: "scale_convergence: failed for attention_mlp/2/weight (iter 4)" then "fallback_to_int8: true". I attached full log in the perf-sweeps dir.

perf-bot: regression_detected: p99 latency +110% in 3/3 runs; affected model: redwood-llama-2-13b-fp8 (variant: fp8-tev2).

raj: hypothesis: calibration failure + hot KV churn -> kernel selector chooses int8 which has a worse fast-path for our fused attention with large seq lengths on L40S. Need to check kernel performance matrix: int8 might use larger workspace or launch configuration that hurts occupancy at sequence >512.

kai: two quick experiments: (1) force fp8 kernels with TE_ENV_FORCE_FP8=1 to see if perf holds (2) throttle batcher to keep seq dist below 512 and measure.

michaela: ran (1) and (2): forcing fp8 removed p99 spikes but we saw a small quality regression on long-tails in the eval set (generation diverged slightly, BLEU down ~0.4). Throttling batcher reduced spikes but throughput dropped ~8%.

olivia: that quality delta is small but might be important for certain customers. Could the calibration failure be flaky? Maybe increase calibration iterations or seed stable quantization table per model checkpoint?

raj: agree. actionable: add a guarded calibration retry (n=3) with deterministic seed, and publish a per-model fallback ranking: prefer fp8 unless calibration fails 3x, then int8. Also add a short hysteresis window in kernel selector to avoid flip-flopping when KV hot-set oscillates.

kai: I'll prototype hysteresis: require 3 consecutive decision ticks before changing kernel. Also add a KV-cache-stability metric to the selector input (hot_set_change_rate). If hot_set_change_rate > threshold, prefer stable kernel (fp8 if calibrated) or a hybrid plan: keep fp8 for attention, int8 for ff if necessary.

michaela: sounds good. Also opened a small perf test to see if int8_dot can be optimized on L40S for seq>512. Might be a kernel-launch param tweak (blocks per SM). Logs in the ticket.

perf-bot: task_created: ENG-3921 "FP8 selector hysteresis + calibration retries" assigned to kai, priority P1.

olivia: one more note: add telemetry tag when fallback happens and include model+checkpoint+seed+calibration-iter to make triage easy.

michaela: added telemetry TODO. I'll run another 12h sweep with hysteresis branch once kai has prototype. Thanks all :thumbsup:
